card.name: Words pointing back to an event
card.fires_on: Words right after a notable event was described, where the next words will refer back to it as 'this experience', 'the bombing' or 'the storm'. Seen in 'took away', 'in the wake', 'benefit from', 'takeaways'.

modes.label: Takeaway phrases
modes.description: Words in 'took away from', 'come away from' or 'takeaways' that lead into 'this experience' or lessons learned.
modes.example: There were at least two things I took<< away>> from this experience.

modes.label: Aftermath and effects
modes.description: Words about what an event led to or who gained from it, such as 'in the wake of' or 'may benefit'.
modes.example: In the<< wake>> of the bombing the museum was rebuilt,

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to continue with a phrase meaning 'this time' or 'this incident', referring back to the event.
card.plain: It fires on words that say what came out of an event, just before the text refers back to that event.
